verdict.line: You lose if you let a Q auto silence you mid-engage or dive him under 30% HP into a hidden Demacian Justice; you win if you land two stacks of Q before he resets with E, since whoever lands hard CC first wins the fight.

brief.thesis: Garen has no ranged poke and no hard CC outside a self-cleanse-plus-silence combo on Q, so this lane is decided by committed all-ins, not chip damage — his Perseverance passive heals back anything short of a full trade. K'Sante's W (Path Maker) stun and a 2-stack Q (Ntofo Strikes) shockwave pull are the only ways to actually lock him down, which is why the measured numbers show an even lane with the solo-kill edge sitting on K'Sante's side despite a 44.3% head-to-head over 3,080 games.

theirWindow.when: Garen flashes the Q move-speed burst
theirWindow.what: Back off immediately. His next auto is empowered and silences on hit — if you're mid-combo when it lands you lose your Q/W/E follow-up and the trade flips.

yourWindow.when: You've landed two Q hits for the shockwave stack
yourWindow.what: Fire the pull immediately and chain straight into W (Path Maker) for the stun. This locks him for your full combo before his E (Judgment, 13-9s CD) comes back up to peel space.

start.why: The highest-picked, highest-win-rate start (44.9% over 2,992 games, 82.6% pick) — Garen has zero ranged poke, so the sustain lets you match his melee auto/E-spin trades without losing the HP war to his Perseverance regen.

boots.why: 82.6% pick for a reason: flat physical damage reduction directly blunts his auto-attacks and the Judgment spin, which are his only two sources of lane damage.

core.why: Adds a proc to Q, letting you stack Ntofo Strikes faster and threaten the 2-stack shockwave pull earlier in every trade.
The Grievous Wounds-adjacent healing cut directly undercuts Garen's Perseverance passive, which is the entire reason poke doesn't work on him.
Stacking resistances let you survive the reduced-defense window during All Out (R) and keep winning extended all-ins into his E/W uptime.

Garen's team builds attack speed or crit and you need the active slow to blunt his spin uptime

runes.keystoneWhy: Procs every time you land Q in melee range, scales your health, and heals you through his no-poke, all-melee kit — exactly the sustain profile this lane needs.

summoners.why: The most-picked combo (68.3% pick, 42.3% win rate) — this lane scales into a split-push/teamfight matchup where Teleport's map pressure matters more than a forced early kill. Flash+Ignite is also live data (41.7% WR, 13.7% pick) if you want to convert your solo-kill edge directly.

playing.title: Respect the Q silence
playing.detail: Garen's Q gives him a slow-cleansing speed burst and an empowered auto that silences on hit. If you see the burst mid-trade, disengage rather than committing your Q/W/E — getting silenced mid-combo loses the fight outright.

playing.title: All-in, don't poke
playing.detail: His Perseverance passive heals back any chip damage you land without follow-up. Every trade should be a full commit into stacked Q plus W stun, not a hit-and-run.

playing.title: Chain Q stacks into W
playing.detail: Land two Ntofo Strikes hits to fire the shockwave pull, then immediately follow with Path Maker's stun before his Judgment (13-9s CD) comes back to let him disengage.

playing.title: Hold E for his spin
playing.detail: Footwork's shield is cheap (8-10s CD) and best timed to absorb the burst from his Judgment spin rather than used purely as a gap-closer.

playing.title: Use R near walls
playing.detail: All Out's initial knockback launches him through terrain — use it near a wall to displace him off minions or away from his turret, but remember your own defenses drop while transformed, so only commit when you're ahead in the trade.

playing.title: Buy Grievous Wounds on curve
playing.detail: Unending Despair's healing cut is non-negotiable here — it's the only item answer to Perseverance, and delaying it lets him regenerate through every trade you win.

playing.title: Don't dive below 30% HP after 6
playing.detail: Demacian Justice executes on missing health and its cooldown drops fast with ranks (140 to 20s). Don't extend a trade or dive a kill once you're low enough that his R becomes lethal.

brief.patchCaveat: The build paths, rune pages, boots, summoners, and win rates above are measured from live OP.GG games on the current patch; the timing reads, the Q-silence danger window, and the all-in logic are my own tactical judgement layered on top of that data.
